scenarios.title: Enable Browse after an ordinary conversation has started
scenarios.expected_contract: The same chat session resumes the nearest recoverable URL turn with Browse enabled.

scenarios.title: Preserve a complete URL followed by natural-language instructions
scenarios.prompt: https://example.test/vehicles?id=42&source=list#details analizza questa pagina e dimmi cosa vedi
scenarios.expected_contract: The exact URL, including query and fragment, is navigated while trailing prose remains user intent.

scenarios.title: Retry after a controlled Browser worker failure
scenarios.expected_contract: Retry reconciles the failed action from durable task state without reviving unrelated history.

scenarios.title: Reload while screenshot evidence is being committed
scenarios.expected_contract: Reload restores a pending action and eventually renders only committed screenshot evidence.

scenarios.title: Reconcile duplicate requests without a duplicate physical action
scenarios.expected_contract: A duplicate idempotency key reuses or reconciles the prior result and never emits TALOS_BROWSER_REPEATED_COMMAND to the user.

scenarios.title: Dismiss a cookie modal through the current verified frame
scenarios.expected_contract: The exact current frame is used, approval is explicit when required, and post-action evidence is committed.

scenarios.title: Keep an inline screenshot visible after reload
scenarios.expected_contract: The chat bubble references an authenticated committed artifact immediately and after reload.

scenarios.title: Reject a provider screenshot claim without committed evidence
scenarios.expected_contract: TALOS never renders or preserves an operational screenshot claim without a correlated committed artifact.

scenarios.title: Fail closed on a worker protocol or capability mismatch
scenarios.expected_contract: Browse remains unavailable with a stable actionable setup fault when worker protocol or capabilities are incompatible.

scenarios.title: Bound malformed tool argument repair to one attempt
scenarios.expected_contract: One deterministic argument repair is allowed; a second malformed result becomes a controlled terminal fault without execution.

scenarios.title: Keep Browser task state attached to the exact owning conversation turn
scenarios.prompt: Inspect the current page and preserve verified evidence.
scenarios.expected_contract: The task card appears once after its exact user turn while pending, migrates to the correlated assistant response, and retains that placement after hard reload.

scenarios.title: Refresh stale interactive evidence in both mobile viewer presentations
scenarios.prompt: Interact with the current verified browser frame.
scenarios.expected_contract: Drawer and fullscreen viewers reject stale coordinates, render the refreshed frame, commit fresh post-action evidence, survive reload, and restore focus to the exact launcher.

scenarios.title: Reject substituted, partial or stale Browser provenance
scenarios.expected_contract: Only the exact persisted Browser call, parent turn, artifact namespace, digest and page state can produce a committed evidence bundle; replay converges on one deterministic usage link.

scenarios.title: Require exact Browser output state, evidence identity and user-message bytes
scenarios.expected_contract: A Browser result is committed only when its canonical digest, exact post-action state, page identity, artifact contract and byte-exact originating user message all agree with persisted state.

scenarios.title: Replay a completed Browser call after provider continuation recovery
scenarios.prompt: Navigate once, then recover the provider continuation.
scenarios.expected_contract: Provider recovery recompiles from the immutable persisted pre-action context, reuses the correlated result, accepts the verified post-action worker state and never dispatches the Browser effect twice.

scenarios.title: Reject unverified artifact bytes and wrong action-output state before correlation
scenarios.expected_contract: No durable run-artifact link exists until the stored bytes match their digest and detected type and the artifact state exactly matches the persisted action output state.

scenarios.title: Reject same-state evidence from another Browser command
scenarios.prompt: correlate the exact browser call result
scenarios.expected_contract: A Browser artifact is correlated only when its source command and pre-action state match the exact persisted tool call and action, even when another command produced evidence at the same output state.

scenarios.title: Keep unowned current-session Browser activity visible without false turn ownership
scenarios.prompt: Capture a browser screenshot from the toolbar.
scenarios.expected_contract: A direct current-session screenshot or approval without a durable task renders once as an explicitly labelled Browser session article, remains actionable across reload where applicable, and never duplicates exact per-turn cards or persisted assistant screenshot evidence.
tests: tests/e2e/talosBrowse.e2e.spec.ts::Browse lifecycle starts a real session and captures screenshot evidence inline
tests/e2e/talosBrowse.e2e.spec.ts::procedural browser approval survives reload and resumes into a persisted answer

scenarios.title: Select mobile Browser viewer presentation explicitly in acceptance coverage
scenarios.prompt: Open the current Browser capture in the configured mobile fullscreen viewer.
scenarios.expected_contract: The mobile Browser HMI viewer uses the persisted Drawer or fullscreen choice deterministically; fullscreen acceptance spans the viewport, traps focus, avoids horizontal overflow and restores the exact launcher without depending on residual settings or test order.

scenarios.title: Cancel the exact Browser task card selected by the human
scenarios.prompt: Stop this Browser task while another task is still active.
scenarios.expected_contract: Every Cancel control carries its immutable task identity through the Vue component chain, resolves it against the current owner-scoped task collection, disables competing task commands in flight and calls only the selected task's version-fenced endpoint.
tests: resources/js/components/talos/chat/TalosBrowserActivity.test.ts::renders accessible compact task state and emits cancellation
resources/js/components/talos/chat/TalosBrowserChatWiring.test.ts::connects current browser state and HMI events through the primary chat surface

scenarios.title: Reload durable Browser task cards while Browse is disabled
scenarios.prompt: Reload this chat after Browser mode has been turned off.
scenarios.expected_contract: The owner-scoped task journal is fetched as safe historical state for the selected chat even when Browse is disabled; TALOS does not create or restore a worker, and repeated polling remains limited to an active Browse request.
